title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for taking photos of a college acquaintance from her private social media account and using AI tools to create obscene images and videos. He then shared this content through multiple fake Instagram, Discord and Facebook accounts, along with several Gmail IDs, to hide his identity. The victim, also 22, reported the harassment to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi after anonymous accounts told her the morphed material was being circulated.

Police say Bansal, a BTech graduate from East Punjabi Bagh, knew the woman from college and acted out of personal resentment after feeling insulted. Investigators recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards and other digital evidence linked to the case. Further investigation is under way.
title_en: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online
